goals.label: Progress the story
goals.goal: Progress the story from the current location using verified live state. Allow trainer and wild encounters. Stop for human help at unknown dialogue, menus, story choices or unclear routes. Stop at safe milestones for the user to make and verify an in-game save.

goals.label: Level up Pokémon
goals.goal: Level up the current party through nearby wild or trainer battles using known walkable tiles. Check current HP, status, move PP and opponent targets before acting. Stop if healing is needed or at move-learning, evolution or unknown menus; let the user decide and save.

goals.label: Explore nearby
goals.goal: Explore nearby known walkable tiles from the current location using live map data. Allow trainer and wild encounters, inspect after every action and do not repeat blocked movement. Stop at unknown prompts or when a route needs human inspection.

goals.label: Finish the current battle
goals.goal: Finish the current battle using verified battle state. Check party HP, status, selected move, PP and opponent target before confirming each action. Do not select unverified Bag or Party menus. Stop when the battle ends, healing is needed, or a move-learning or evolution prompt appears.
